cards.title: Basic
cards.body: The 'Blitz' package. High-performance 1-3 page landing sites built for local service providers. Includes local integration, mobile optimization, and sub-500ms load times.

cards.title: Pro
cards.body: Full lead-generation systems. Up to 10 pages with advanced 'Sovereign' routing, custom AI Agent integration for 24/7 lead capture, and full Google Search Console strategy.

cards.title: Premier
cards.body: Bespoke full-stack applications. Custom system design and development, specialized cloud provisioning, and direct implementation specialist consulting.
